text: とくべつに　グレンじま　まで　むかえに　きて　もろたんや

structure.en: all the way to Cinnabar Island

structure.jp: むかえに　きて　もろたんや
structure.en: I had him come to pick me up

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus もらう says you get someone to do it for you; もろた is Kansai dialect for もらった. きて もろたんや = 'I had him come, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に before a verb of coming or going shows what you come to do. むかえに きて = 'come to pick me up'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んや is Kansai dialect for んだ, which makes a statement sound like an explanation. もろたんや = 'the thing is, I got him to'.
